item.title: Philip Rivers chokes up talking about possibly playing his last game
item.description: Philip Rivers may have made his final NFL start on Sunday against the Jaguars, and he said he would not un-retire for a second time.

item.title: WISH-TV in Pasadena for IU in the Rose Bowl
item.description: IU is 13-0 and will face No. 9 Alabama in the Rose Bowl on January 1st, with quarterback Fernando Mendoza looking to lead the Hoosiers to their first Rose Bowl victory.

item.title: Anderson mom fatally shoots teen daughter; mom in police custody
item.description: An Anderson mom was arrested after she fatally shot her 17-year-old daughter at their home early Sunday morning, with no disturbance reported before the incident.

item.title: Colts fall to Jaguars, lose sixth straight game
item.description: The Colts lost to the Jaguars 23-17, marking their sixth straight loss and dropping their record to 8-8, while Philip Rivers reflected on his last three games with the team.

item.title: Fox Corp. seeks to move Mark Sanchez lawsuit to federal court
item.description: Fox Corporation has filed a motion to move a lawsuit stemming from former NFL quarterback Mark Sanchez's downtown Indianapolis fight to federal court, claiming that Sanchez and Fox are both out-of-state defendants and that Huse Culinary was fraudulently joined to the lawsuit to prevent the case from moving to federal court.

item.title: Christmas spending on credit cards leads to serious debt for shoppers
item.description: Christmas spending has increased this year, resulting in many families facing serious debt due to high interest charges on credit cards.

item.title: Cold and blustery start to the work week | Dec. 28, 2025
item.description: A narrow line of showers and storms moves through early this evening, followed by a rapid temperature crash and a risk of a quick freeze, and then a cold, windy week with highs in the upper 20s to mid 30s and wind chills near zero at times.
